GrandPrix:24 hours of le mans (24 Hours of Le Mans): A race event.
An annual 24-hour automobile race held in Le Mans, France.
A prestigious endurance race.
An annual 24-hour automobile endurance race held in Le Mans, France.
A prestigious racing event where several victories were achieved.

Season:1948 (1948): A season in which Ferrari achieved significant racing victories.
The year when the Tipo 125 made its debut.
Season:1949 (1949): A season in which Ferrari continued its streak of victories.

Team:af corse (AF Corse): A team that achieved success in major international GT2 and GTE Pro/GTLM competitions.
A team that scored four GTE Pro class wins at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
Car:ferrari 166 mm (Ferrari 166 MM): A 2-litre sports car that won multiple prestigious races.

Driver:antonio giovinazzi (Antonio Giovinazzi): The driver who received a penalty that affected the grid for the Macau Grand Prix.
An Italian racing driver and close friend of Kimi Räikkönen.
Crashed at Campus corner during the Belgian Grand Prix.
Giovinazzi retired during the race.

GrandPrix:targa florio (Targa Florio): A historic automobile race held in Sicily.
A race where lighter cars could be competitive.

Season:1951 (1951): The year Juan Manuel Fangio won the championship.
A season in which Ferrari won at the Carrera Panamericana.
A Formula One season.
Car:ferrari 166 s (Ferrari 166 S): A sports car model that achieved international success in racing.

Driver:alessandro pier guidi (Alessandro Pier Guidi): A driver who raced the Ferrari 488 GTE.
A driver who raced for Ferrari.

A driver who raced the Ferrari 488 GTE.
A driver who raced for Ferrari.
